title: Snow Peak trivia questions
description: A list of multiple-choice trivia questions for import on the Trivia > Questions page, as JSON. The root may be either a bare array of questions or an object with a `questions` array.

choice.description: An option's text (case-insensitive) or its 0-based index.

text.description: The question as shown on the projector and phones.

options.description: Either a list of 2–20 answer choices, or the string "players" to use every guest's name as the choices (a "who said this?" question). Defaults to "players" when omitted.

answer.description: The correct choice: the option text (case-insensitive) or its 0-based index. Required unless options is "players", where it defaults to `about`. A list of choices makes a "select all that apply" question, scored all-or-nothing.

multi.description: True for a "select all that apply" question. Implied when `answer` is a list; set explicitly only for a multi-select question with one correct option.

about.description: Name of the guest this question is about. Shown on the reveal. Required when options is "players".
